query: For a 58‑year‑old woman: among female ICU patients aged 53–63 with sepsis, what are the 75th and 90th percentiles of procedures in the first 24 hours? Compare to age‑matched ICU patients and report average ICU LOS and hospital mortality.
final_sql:
WITH SepsisPatients AS (
  -- Identify patients with sepsis based on ICD-9 codes
  SELECT DISTINCT
    p.subject_id,
    p.gender,
    p.anchor_age,
    a.admittime,
    a.hadm_id,
    a.hospital_expire_flag
  FROM `physionet-data.mimiciv_3_1_hosp.patients` AS p
  JOIN `physionet-data.mimiciv_3_1_hosp.admissions` AS a
    ON p.subject_id = a.subject_id
  JOIN `physionet-data.mimiciv_3_1_hosp.diagnoses_icd` AS d
    ON p.subject_id = d.subject_id AND a.hadm_id = d.hadm_id
  WHERE
    p.gender = 'F'
    AND p.anchor_age BETWEEN 53 AND 63
    AND d.icd_code IN ('001', '001.0', '001.1', '001.2', '001.3', '001.4', '001.5', '001.6', '001.7', '001.8', '001.9', '462', '4;
